name: tts-tools
description: Local TTS Editor plus savefile/xmlbundle libraries and TTS gateway

scripts.build:libs: npm run build --prefix packages/xmlbundle && npm run build --prefix packages/savefile
scripts.build:editor: npm run compile --prefix packages/tts-editor && npm run copy-gateway --prefix packages/tts-editor
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:gateway && npm run build:client && npm run build:editor
scripts.package: npm run build && npm install --prefix packages/tts-editor && npm run vscode:package --prefix packages/tts-editor
